title: narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. cyclamineus
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. cyclamineus, commonly known as Daffodil or Jonquil, is a plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Narcissus pseudonarcissus subsp. cyclamineus include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids such as galantamine and lycorine, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and anticholinesterase properties.
